758:t_1:47.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... $$クロウ$$ seems to be weighed down by his debt, but I wonder what everyone else is up to by now...」

758:t_1:48.en:
$$エスター$$
「I'm sure they're all doing their best in their own worlds. After all, they're everyone from $c!」

758:t_1:53.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm not going anywhere ever again. I'll live on in this world, together with you.」

758:t_1:54.en:
$$桂$$
「Right now I'm not the $$特異点$$. I'm just $$桂木桂$$... $$桂木桂$$ who belongs to you alone.」

758:t_1:55.en:
$$シャイア$$
「You two... Getting lovey-dovey on the bridge is against the rules.」

758:t_1:56.en:
$$ジャビー$$
「Please go to the living room right away. The Captain is struggling with the twin babies.」

758:t_1:57.en:
$$ミムジィ$$
「I'm sorry, $$シャイア$$, $$ジャビー$$.」

758:t_1:58.en:
$$桂$$
「Still, I was surprised that the Captain had come back to life.」

758:t_1:59.en:
$$ミムジィ$$
「It seems the Captain traveled through all sorts of worlds of the multiverse and went through a lot.」

758:t_1:60.en:
$$桂$$
「And then he came back to this world through the true $$時空修復|lc$$, huh?」

758:t_1:61.en:
$$モーム$$
「Honestly, $$桂$$! Looking after babies is a father's job!」

758:t_1:63.en:
$$アテナ$$
「Even the $$特異点$$ who saved the world is a pushover in front of his kids.」

758:t_1:64.en:
$$オルソン$$
「But that is exactly what $$桂$$ has been seeking all along.」

758:t_1:65.en:
$$アテナ$$
「Coming back here... He kept on fighting to make that happen, didn't he.」

758:t_1:66.en:
$$オルソン$$
「The same goes for me, though.」

758:t_1:67.en:
$$桂$$
「Quit watching like it's someone else's problem, $$オルソン$$! You look after your little brother and sister too!」

758:t_1:69.en:
$$シャイア$$
「That's right. $$桂$$'s kids will be $$アテナ$$'s younger siblings, after all.」

758:t_1:70.en:
$$ジャビー$$
「That makes them your younger siblings too, $$オルソン$$, since you married $$アテナ$$.」

758:t_1:71.en:
$$桂$$
「Exactly, partner. Let's savor this happiness together.」

758:t_1:72.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Right. Then I think I'll take you up on that.」

758:t_1:73.en:
$$桂$$
(The hyperdimensional world born through the multiverse... This is the world where I and the ones I love will live.)

758:t_1:74.en:
$$桂$$
(Someday I want to show everyone, too... the happiness I've grasped.)

758:t_1:79.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Today's finally the tournament semifinal, $$キリコ$$. It's only $$バトリング$$, but to win your way through against such tough fighters... all I can say is, impressive.」

758:t_1:80.en:
$$ココナ$$
「If you win this one, it's the final...! And if you win the whole thing, we'll rake in the prize money!」

758:t_1:81.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Well, it's just a regular game. Compared to a $$リアルバトル$$, it's not much of an amount.」

758:t_1:82.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I won't fire a gun anymore. Not until the time comes when it's needed.」

758:t_1:85.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Right? For $$フィアナ$$'s sake, too.」

758:t_1:88.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「The first semifinal match is over. As expected, $$テイタニア$$ won.」

758:t_1:89.en:
$$バニラ$$
「That means $$キリコ$$'s opponent in the final is $$テイタニア$$!」

758:t_1:90.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「You're getting ahead of yourself. $$キリコ$$ is still in the semifinal.」

758:t_1:91.en:
$$ココナ$$
「What are you saying, Pops! There's no way $$キリコ$$ loses!」

758:t_1:93.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Win, $$キリコ$$. You beat me, after all.」

758:t_1:95.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I want to use the prize money to give $$バニラ$$ and $$ココナ$$ a wedding present, too.」

758:t_1:97.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Now that's a help! With that we can finally open a $$ファンタムクラブ$$ in $$クメン$$, too!」

758:t_1:98.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「That place has settled down too, thanks to the hard work of $$ポタリア$$ and the others.」

758:t_1:99.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$キデーラ$$ keeps urging us to show our faces there, too.」

758:t_1:100.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Well then, let's treat ourselves to a trip to $$クメン$$, with $$キリコ$$-chan's championship as the souvenir!」

758:t_1:103.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Make some coffee and wait for me.」

758:t_1:104.en:
$$キリコ$$
(I won't pick up a gun again. Not unless someone shows up who tries to drag $$フィアナ$$ and me into a fight...)

758:t_1:105.en:
$$キリコ$$
(This peaceful life I won together with my comrades from $c may be only fleeting... But even so, that's fine...)

758:t_1:106.en:
$$キリコ$$
(I'll live with $$フィアナ$$... Today... and tomorrow, too...)

758:t_1:111.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I see! So you sing too!」

758:t_1:112.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Wait, $$バサラ$$! Have you forgotten that running off like that is how you got caught up in a $$時空震動$$!?」

758:t_1:113.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「It's pointless to tell him, $$ミレーヌ$$. This guy doesn't care one bit that he got warped to another world.」

758:t_1:114.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バトル７$$, please respond! This is Captain $$ガムリン・木崎$$ of the $$ダイヤモンドフォース$$! I have found $$熱気バサラ$$!」

758:t_1:115.en:
$$マックス$$
「This is $$バトル７$$. If possible, bring $$熱気バサラ$$ back to the fleet.」

758:t_1:117.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Even you can't stop my song, $$ガムリン$$!」

758:t_1:118.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Sorry, $$バサラ$$! Today I'm catching you no matter what!」

758:t_1:119.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Because when you wander off like that, I get fewer chances to make a move on $$ミレーヌ$$!」

758:t_1:121.en:
$$ビヒーダ$$
「Stop looking so pleased and settle this quickly.」

758:t_1:122.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Shut up, $$ガムリン$$! Nobody can stop me!」

758:t_1:123.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I sing as much as I want, whenever I want!」

758:t_1:125.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Whenever you want to sing? That's all the time!」

758:t_1:127.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Honestly! If you keep wandering around like that, you won't even be able to go see everyone!」

758:t_1:128.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't worry. I'll get my sound to those guys, too.」

758:t_1:130.en:
$$バサラ$$
「That's why I'll burn my heart out and sing today, too!」

758:t_1:131.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Space whales, galaxies, dimensions! Listen to my soooong!!」

758:t_1:136.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That guy again... flying around the sky in his EX-Gear?」

758:t_1:137.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Yes... He said he really took a liking to the sky of this new planet.」
